headline: Supreme Court Notice to Goa Police and Tarun Tejpal
summary: The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Goa Police and Tarun Tejpal regarding his challenge against his 2013 rape conviction. The court sought a response from the Goa government on the matter.

headline: Goa Electoral System Facing Flak Over Missing Voters
summary: Valid Goa voters claim they were left out of electoral rolls despite multiple email communications. The Indian Express report highlighted flaws in the system, prompting responses from election authorities.

headline: Goa Congress Protests Over SIR and Demands CEC Arrest
summary: Goa Congress staged protests regarding voter list issues and demanded the arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Meanwhile, state BJP leaders accused Congress of constantly changing its political issues.

headline: CEO Goa Clarifies Status of Missing Electors
summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa assured that no eligible elector will be left behind. Authorities clarified that the cases of the 97 disputed voters were processed separately and many were added.

headline: BCCI Confirms Goa as Host for IPL 2027 Auction
summary: The BCCI has officially confirmed that Goa will host the IPL 2027 auction in mid-December. Cricket board officials made the announcement regarding the upcoming event.

headline: Political Shifts and Alliances in Goa
summary: The AAP-GFP alliance in Goa is currently facing strong political challenges from the Congress party. Additionally, remarks from Karnataka's Deputy Speaker regarding merging Uttara Kannada with Goa stirred regional debates.

headline: Actor Vishal Krishna Injured During Goa Stunt Shoot
summary: South Indian actor Vishal Krishna sustained injuries while performing a stunt sequence for a project in Goa. He was attended to following the mishap on set.

headline: Goa Government Launches Youth Skills and AI Initiative
summary: The Goa government has rolled out the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan initiative aimed at enhancing youth skills and artificial intelligence training. The program seeks to empower the local workforce.

headline: Nationalised Bank Unions Announce Three-Day Strike
summary: Bank employees across nationalised unions have announced a three-day nationwide strike starting September 28. The industrial action is expected to impact banking services in regions including Goa.

headline: Calangute Police Detain Two Individuals for Halting Work
summary: Police in Calangute detained two persons for allegedly disrupting and stopping ongoing construction work. Authorities intervened following complaints at the site.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Sanjivani Sugar Factory Redevelopment
summary: The Goa cabinet has officially cleared the proposal for the redevelopment of the Sanjivani sugar factory. The move aims to revive operations at the facility.

headline: Kerala Overtakes Goa as Top Adventure Tourism Spot
summary: An industry expert noted that Kerala has surpassed Goa to become India's leading adventure tourism destination. Meanwhile, tourism stakeholders pointed out navigation omissions on local maps.

headline: Labour Welfare Boards Adopt Digital ERP Systems
summary: Labour welfare boards in the region are transitioning to digital platforms by implementing new Enterprise Resource Planning systems. The upgrade aims to streamline administrative processes.

headline: KTC Focuses on Driver Efficiency to Combat Fuel Costs
summary: The Kadamba Transport Corporation is turning to driver efficiency training to cope with rising diesel expenditures. The measure seeks to optimize fuel consumption across its fleet.

headline: Goa Revises Taxi Fare Structure, Making Rides Costlier
summary: The Goa government has officially revised the state's taxi fare structure, resulting in increased travel costs for commuters. Transport unions and passengers have reacted to the new rates.

headline: Atal Setu Opens for Porvorim Traffic
summary: Vehicles from Porvorim are slated to gain entry to the Atal Setu bridge, with traffic authorities working on a comprehensive management plan. The move aims to ease congestion on major routes.

headline: Goa Shipyard Records Highest Ever Revenue in FY 2025-26
summary: Goa Shipyard Limited announced a record-breaking revenue of Rs 4,004 crore for the financial year 2025-26. The milestone highlights strong financial performance in defense manufacturing.

headline: Celebrities Share Nostalgic Memories of Weddings in Goa
summary: Actors and public figures have reflected on their fond memories of attending celebrations and weddings in Goa. The coastal state remains a popular backdrop for personal milestones and gatherings.

headline: Monsoon Deficit Threatens Forest Ecology and Fungi Growth
summary: A recorded deficit in Goa's monsoon rainfall has severely reduced fungi growth, raising concerns among ecologists about forest health. Experts warn that altered weather patterns impact local biodiversity.

headline: Forest Department Foils Illegal Teak Smuggling Bid
summary: The Goa Forest Department intercepted and thwarted an attempt to smuggle illegally felled teak logs in Avedem. Authorities are investigating the unauthorized tree-cutting operation.

headline: Police Crackdown Ordered Against Resurfaced Fake Call Centres
summary: Following links found to scams in Lucknow and Kolkata, Goa's DGP has directed police forces to take immediate action against illegal call centers. Past operations in the state are under scrutiny.

headline: Mormugao Port Trust to Host Seafarers’ Welfare Centre
summary: The central government has granted approval for the establishment of a dedicated seafarers’ welfare centre at Mormugao. The facility will cater to the needs of visiting maritime workers.

headline: Truck Allegedly Dumps Hazardous Waste in Honda
summary: Locals reported a truck allegedly dumping hazardous industrial waste in the Honda area of Goa. Authorities have been urged to investigate the environmental violation.
